benefit_gate.effective_comparison: ndu_control versus validation-selected efficient static system/mode
benefit_gate.single_view_comparison: same ndu_control weights: continuation versus cheaper no-critic one-pass random view; not an isolated routing-mechanism effect or matched continuation opportunities

plan.build_cpu_attribution: entire system build CPU including shared preparation, all three seeds and LR search, divided by three selected seeds; each selected seed serves H requests
plan.calibration: fixed training-only stratified matching: six distinct physical sources per each of twelve source classes and six rows per each of twelve target classes, interleaved across classes, three repeats; reference full-service CPU median from first shared base; request CPU includes processing, controller, real generation, sampled caption/PNG and JSON serialization
plan.candidate_execution_order: seed/LR rounds; systems rotated by round index; only active per-system CPU is attributed

controller.cost_calibration: same fitted critic and model on the 72 frozen TRAIN calibration inputs; forced stop bounds [0,0] and continue bounds [1,1] at decision price 0.5; complete low+critic, optional full, PNG/caption/JSON and ledger CPU; three paired repeats, AB/BA order by (repeat + model seed index) modulo 2, common sample seed model_seed+1009*repeat; per-request paired delta median is clamped below at zero then divided by frozen full-service reference CPU; no minimum timing or validation-driven threshold selection; all probe costs charged only to ndu_control
controller.decision: predicted full-minus-low raw decoded task utility exceeds decision_price = compute_price * cost_ratio; compute_price remains 0.02 for total net utility
controller.input: first cheap thumbnail content distributions only
controller.input_router: implemented optional candidate, not searched or qualified in r2

plan.cpu_bootstrap_clusters: fixed 64-request runtime batch cohorts crossed with model seed; raw content metrics retain physical-source clusters; CPU claims are conditional on this frozen batching profile
plan.cpu_failure_policy: after each phase, preserve partial ledger and stop further work immediately if actual complete per-system CPU exceeds the unchanged cap
plan.diagnostic_telemetry: phase CPU/wall/main-thread CPU, rusage, process threads, bounded GC pauses and read-only container counter deltas; container counters alone do not establish a process-level cause
plan.formal_measurement_order: seed rounds; systems rotated by seed index; within each bundle full, selected, then frozen random where applicable
plan.no_padding: only applied objective kernels execute; cached fixed decoder objective and one encoder forward per update; cheaper systems spend savings on extra updates up to the same build caps; static baselines do not fit or run an unused critic
plan.output_sampling_profile: batched inverse-CDF with preserved (n,2) draw ordering, exact left-edge/clamp behavior and batch pixel quantization; actual per-request PNG, hash, base64 and JSON unchanged; declared sampling arithmetic and all-CDF comparisons charged
plan.r1_policy: sealed forever; no retraining, tuning or re-evaluation against r1 held-out
plan.refinement: after one fixed LR/mode selection, all arms may continue their selected three-seed models using original Adam and RNG state in rotated complete seed rounds; no validation-based stopping or reselection; reserve exact future operators and training-only CPU forecasts for critic, paired calibration, selected service, changed-model revalidation and exports; actual caps remain authoritative
plan.runtime_profile: fixed batches up to 64 requests; complete batch CPU and latency retained; not a single-request latency qualification
plan.scope: independent physical-source synthetic text/image qualification; fixed-rho entropic utility
plan.selected_validation_order: seed rounds; systems rotated by seed index; optional critic fitting fully charged to its system
plan.selection: global LR and static mode maximize mean validation decoded utility minus measured training-calibrated CPU price; control LR selected by this same content rule before train-only critic fit; selected residual training never reselects LR or mode
plan.test_policy: one experiment-wide exclusive marker before first test construction; no new-directory repeat or threshold change
plan.validation_readiness: do not open test if required validation mean contrasts are nonpositive, greedy retention fails, or a build budget is violated; retain nonzero readiness receipts
